verdict.rationale: Quo documents a public API with key generation, Authorization-header auth, standardized JSON responses, and per-key rate limits, and markets it as one 'your own agent can read and act on'. However, the pack shows no endpoint-level reference for the operations an agent would actually drive, and every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404. missing for 10: endpoint-level API reference showing which product actions (messages, calls, contacts) are exposed, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Quo API enables developers to integrate powerful communication features directly into their applications and workflows.
Click “Generate API key” and provide a descriptive label. Each key provides full API access.
Include your API key in the Authorization header of each request: `Authorization: YOUR_API_KEY`
Each API key may make up to 10 requests per second.
an API your own agent can read and act on
